properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 7:38AM PDT until October 16 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts of 35 to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Calabasas and Agoura Hills, Central Ventura County Valleys,
Eastern San Fernando Valley, Eastern Santa Monica Mountains
Recreational Area, Northern Ventura County Mountains, Santa Clarita
Valley, Southeastern Ventura County Valleys, Southern Ventura
County Mountains, and Western San Fernando Valley.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

In the event of a nearby wildfire, smoke may increase heat and
physical stress. If smoke impacts your area; 1) Have a cooling plan
in place as smoke could limit your ability to cool your home through
open windows and 2) If you have air conditioning, set on air
recirculation within the home to avoid smoke exposure. Local
officials may have additional guidance.

NWSheadline: WIND ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 PM PDT FRIDAY
